home.title: Arda Senturk
home.subtitle: iOS & React-Native Developer
home.description: I build private, fast and beautiful apps for iPhone, iPad and Apple Watch — natively with SwiftUI and cross-platform with React-Native — plus open-source tools that make shipping apps easier.

about.title: About Me
about.description1: I have been involved in software development for approximately 15 years, and currently have multiple applications live on both the App Store and Play Store. I have been working as a React-Native Developer at a company for over 3 years, expanding my experience through various projects during this time.
about.description2: Throughout my career, I have participated in different projects and provided various training sessions. I have developed many projects with React-Native, NestJS, NodeJS, Unity and Swift. Recently I rebuilt my own apps natively in SwiftUI, with Apple Watch apps, widgets, Apple Health and Siri support.
about.description3: I also build open-source developer tools around AI coding agents such as Claude Code — from automating App Store listings to driving coding agents on my Mac from my iPhone. My passion for continuous learning keeps me current and helps me deliver the best solutions in my projects.

contact.title: Get In Touch
contact.subtitle: I'm always interested in new opportunities and collaborations. Let's connect and discuss how we can work together!

projects.title: My Projects
projects.subtitle: Apps live on the App Store, apps launching soon, and open-source tools I share on GitHub.

comingSoon.title: Coming Soon
comingSoon.subtitle: Finished apps on their way to the App Store. Their websites are already live.

openSource.title: Open Source
openSource.subtitle: Tools and apps whose code is public on GitHub, MIT licensed.

weightly.title: Weightly
weightly.description: Weight tracker with a smart trend line that smooths out daily swings, so you always see where you're really heading. No account, no ads, your data stays on your devices.
weightly.update: Version 2.0 is a complete native SwiftUI rebuild: weekly rate and goal date range, two-way Apple Health sync, interactive widgets, Apple Watch and Siri.

finly.title: Finly
finly.description: Budget and expense log for iPhone and Apple Watch. Type “coffee 4.50” and you're done — Finly picks the category, keeps you on budget and reminds you of subscriptions. No account, no bank login.
finly.update: Finly 2 is rebuilt natively for iOS; version 2.0.1 adds iPhone Duo layouts and improved landscape and larger-text support.

lunavia.title: Lunavia
lunavia.description: Private period and cycle tracker. Predictions for your next period and fertile window, symptom logging in seconds and sourced health articles — everything stays on your iPhone.
lunavia.update: Launched on the App Store in October 2026, in 14 languages.

howWell.title: How Well?
howWell.description: Fun question-and-answer game that can be played among friends. Test how well you know each other and have a good time.

kickoff.title: Kickoff
kickoff.description: Football live scores, lineups, stats and alerts from thousands of competitions, free. Kickoff Pro adds AI forecasts for every match and lets you manage the team yourself.
kickoff.update: Live Activities, universal links for shared matches and a website in 14 languages.

atleva.title: Atleva
atleva.description: No-equipment home workouts. Pick a goal, tap your focus areas on the body map and get a plan that adapts to how you feel, with 119 exercise videos that work offline.

vitrin.title: Vitrin
vitrin.description: Builds your whole store listing from your app's code: ASO metadata, screenshots, creatives and App Preview videos, validated against Apple's and Google's rules and uploaded only after your approval. Runs inside Claude Code.
vitrin.update: Version 1.0.0 released in October 2026, with Vitrin Studio, a local web UI for the whole flow.

remoteCode.title: Remote Code
remoteCode.description: Drive Claude Code, Codex and Gemini CLI on your Mac from your iPhone or iPad. Follow responses, diffs and terminal output live and approve every action — end-to-end encrypted, no server, no account.
remoteCode.update: Version 1.2.0: Mac app via DMG or Homebrew, iPhone app on TestFlight.

a11y.title: RN Accessibility Automation
a11y.description: Self-hosted accessibility crawler for Expo and React Native apps. Explores screens with Appium, audits elements against WCAG 2.2 and shows the results in a local dashboard.

pinGenerator.title: Map Pin Generator
pinGenerator.description: Small TypeScript tool that turns SVG icons into map pin PNGs in any size and writes the marker list to mapSettings.json.
